elements.manual_reason: The translucent blue navigation drawer is fully gone in the end frame, so no candidate box isolates it; region is where it sat over the left of the report.
elements.label: Blue navigation drawer fading out over the Actuals Import Check report
App window with the Actuals Import Check report scaling down slightly and drifting up-left inside the frame

pattern.description: On the new page, the translucent navigation drawer fades away in a frame or two, uncovering the Actuals Import Check P&L table, while the whole app window eases a few percent smaller inside the frame.
pattern.why_premium: The menu does not hard-cut away: it dissolves off the destination page while the window settles back, so the click to the result reads as one continuous move.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.nav-drawer', {opacity: 0, xPercent: -20, duration: 0.12, ease: 'power2.out'}).to('.app-window', {scale: 0.955, x: -18, y: -8, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out'}, 0); report content static inside the window.
build_hint.remotion: Drawer opacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 3], [1, 0], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); window scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 6], [1, 0.955], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); ease rather than spring.

notes: Continues e026 (window scale-down that started there). Camera verdict is none, so the scale (0.9547) is read as the app window wrapper shrinking inside the frame, not a camera move. The drawer needs a manual box because it has disappeared by the end frame. No SFX candidates.
